modifications: Codec int8-row-v1: rank-4 float32 ArraysCache slots (and their recorded prefill checkpoints) stored as int8 + one float32 scale per row of the last axis, RTN, qmax 127; nonfinite rows decode to NaN; self-describing record (uint8 codec tag) that rides COW cloning and save/load_prompt_cache.
Selected by cache capability (ArraysCache slot dtype/rank), never by model name.

APCv2 encodes a store-private copy (live caches and rollback records untouched), decodes request-private restores in _copy_prompt_cache_for_restore, validates every disk restore (codec match, structure, finite positive scales, payload in [-127,127]) and fails closed.
Namespace law recurrent-state-codec-v1 wraps the APCv2 semantic namespace (outermost; identity when off); APCv2 refuses store/lookup whose key layer does not match its own codec.
